summary: Residential kerb where cars already park; homes within about 15 m on this side.
reasons: Several cars parked along this kerb
Houses 14 m or more behind the kerb
Near level at the best section

best_section.where: Ivy Street north kerb, opposite the tennis court, between the two parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Houses and driveways back onto the kerb on the north side at about 14 m or more; tennis court and trees opposite.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked along the kerb, so there is room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Cars and a boat trailer park here, so a van will not stand out, but homes are close.

flags: Signs: No Stopping Any Time near both ends of the stretch; keep to the middle
Slope about 3% at best section; 14% max at the top end
sun_shade: Trees shade the top end; the middle is open, with some shade from the north side houses in the morning.
cannot_judge: Which of the tagged buildings are dwellings
